note: R6-D: each case settled (an action, where one, at T1 and settled), `pens` = the sorted set of stroke|width|dash|offset|ends of every stroked path under the series views (lineWidth > 0, a stroke not null nor none) -- of the part `part` names where one is (symbol: a radar item's symbols; pointer / progress: a gauge's; ribbon: a chord's links) -- the stroke #rrggbbaa (color.parse), grad a gradient, x:<word> a word that does not parse; the dash normalizeLineDash'd against the width (solid none, ignored one setLineDash does not take); the offset 0 where none; the ends cap/join/miterLimit, butt/miter/10 where none. `seen` the paths of that part, `n` the stroked ones. R6-E: a pen whose path scales with it (no strokeNoScale, a scaling transform: a pictorial glyph) as drawn, its width, dash and offset times sqrt|det| to four places; the offset as the canvas takes it (Number); part track: the bands of a gauge axis line; `shapes` each path of the part as type|cx|cy|r0|r|clockwise start|sweep (sector, sausage), circle|cx|cy|r, rect|x|y|w|h (canvas frame); `fills` the fills of the part; `hits` [x, y, the part findHover finds there, empty another path, - none]; `at`: sampled at T0 + at, animating.
